name: BotForge369 After-Hours Lead Bot
author: botforge369

sections.description:
When your office is closed, visitors with a leaking pipe or a dead furnace usually leave. This plugin puts a small chat assistant on your site that answers them, takes their details, and emails the lead to you so you can call back first thing.

The assistant asks for:

  • name and phone number
  • the service needed: plumbing, HVAC, electrical or other
  • the address or ZIP code
  • how urgent it is: emergency, this week, or just a quote
  • a good time to call

It sets honest expectations (“the team will call you back first thing”). It never promises an arrival time or a price. If a visitor describes danger, such as a gas smell or sparking wiring, it tells them to get safe and call 911 or their utility first.

Free plan: a monthly number of AI conversations per site. Past that, the chat still takes each visitor’s name and phone number for you, without the AI. Paid plans remove the limit and the “Powered by BotForge” line. See plans.

More about the after-hours bot: botforge369.com/for/home-services

This plugin uses an external service

This plugin is the WordPress front end of BotForge (https://botforge369.com), a hosted chat service. The chat does not work without a BotForge account (a free one is enough).

What is sent, and when:

  • When you click Connect in Settings → BotForge369 After-Hours Lead Bot: your connection key, your site’s address and the plugin version are sent to BotForge, to link the site to your bot. Nothing is sent before you click Connect.
  • When the chat is switched on, your pages load the chat script from botforge369.com. When a visitor uses the chat, the messages they type, and the name, phone, email, address and call time they give, are sent to BotForge to reply to them and to send you the lead. BotForge uses an AI model provider (Anthropic) to write the replies.
  • Nothing else about your visitors or your site is sent by this plugin. The plugin sets no cookies of its own and adds no tracking.

BotForge Terms of Service · Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → BotForge369 After-Hours Lead Bot.
  3. Click Create a free BotForge account, or I have an account: get my key if you already have one.
  4. On the BotForge page, enter your business name and click Get my connection key. Copy the key.
  5. Back in WordPress, paste the key and click Connect.
  6. Click Turn on. The chat bubble now appears on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BotForge account?

Yes. The assistant runs on BotForge. A free account is enough to start.

Where do leads go?

To your email, and to your BotForge dashboard, where you can also export them.

What happens when the free plan’s monthly limit is reached?

The chat keeps working without the AI: it takes the visitor’s name and phone number and sends them to you. Nobody is turned away.

Does it send text messages?

No. Leads arrive by email only.

Can I change what the assistant says?

Yes. In your BotForge dashboard you can edit the greeting, the questions, your services, prices and hours.

Does the plugin slow my site down?

It adds one small script, loaded in the footer, and only when the chat is switched on.

How do I remove it?

Click Disconnect, then deactivate and delete the plugin. Deleting it removes its settings from WordPress. Your bot and leads stay in your BotForge account until you delete them there.
